'''Ran Niall''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] turned [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]. In his time as an Imperial, he was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. When Ran saw the [[Massacre on Mon Cala|atrocities]] the Empire had committed on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]], he became a turncoat, and joined the Rebel Alliance. He mentored [[Setenna Hase]] and [[Danel Qurno]], teaching them everything he could. Ran was eventually killed during the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]] in an explosion after being left behind at [[Arda Base]].

==Legacy==
When the [[Ardan resistance]] arrived on [[Jagomir]], people felt remorse for Ran. People remembered his tough love when a rebel hotshot tried to get info from his peers by being extremely charismatic.
